key_insight: Asymptomatic female carriers of the XDP-associated TAF1 variant showed clear striatal neurodegeneration and iron accumulation on MRI despite no overt clinical symptoms.
clinical_relevance: This suggests female carriers may have measurable brain changes long before disease onset, supporting earlier monitoring and biomarker-based follow-up in research settings.
method: 103 female relatives of XDP patients were evaluated with clinical testing, genetics, and multimodal MRI.
42 participants were classified as female mutation carriers and 61 as healthy controls.
Structural MRI and susceptibility-weighted imaging were used to assess gray-matter volume and iron deposition, with a longitudinal subset followed over time.
evidence_signal: Compared with controls, female carriers had markedly lower caudate, putamen, and pallidum volumes (all p<0.001), plus increased caudate iron deposition; no significant progression was seen over up to 25.5 months.
watch_item: The study is observational and follow-up was relatively short, so the findings do not establish when or how quickly clinical disease will develop.
paper_title: Preclinical Basal Ganglia Neurodegeneration in Female X Linked Dystonia Parkinsonism Carriers
